nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Moisturizer

avis.texte: This moisturizer is amazing ! I am loving the jar and how so little of this goes a long way . It has been great to my skin . I love that it has SPF 30 ! The texture is very creamy and feels lightweight and non greasy . I love the glow it gives once it's fully absorbed . My makeup layers beautifully over it as well . I use this everyday and I highly recommend it .
I've been using this product daily for over 15 years and I absolutely love it. I'm not a makeup gal anymore and I love how my face feels when I apply this every morning.

avis.titre: This is a must have daily sunscreen
avis.texte: I am always in the market for a good daily SPF skincare to use. I think I have found the perfect one. This goes on so smooth and makes my skin feel so hydrated, but it also protects it. It does have a fragrance, but I noticed that dissipates and doesn't linger to interfere with other scent you wear. The SPF 30 Is lightweight and doesn't have any kind of cast to it on my skin. I recently took a loved one to have a skin cancer removed from their face. After seeing that I can tell you, everyone should wear sunscreen daily!

I was a loyal customer because the original Hope in a Jar was truly one of a kind. It was lightweight, absorbed beautifully, and left my skin feeling hydrated without any greasy residue. My skin loved it, and it became my favorite moisturizer. Unfortunately, after the formula change, the experience is completely different. The added sunscreen makes the cream feel heavy, greasy, and uncomfortable on my skin. It leaves a shiny finish that looks and feels oily throughout the day. Instead of making my skin look healthy, it now makes it look worse. I was so disappointed that I ended up throwing both jars away. I really wish Philosophy would bring back the original formula or at least offer a version without sunscreen. It was a perfect moisturizer before, and it's heartbreaking to see such an amazing product changed so drastically.

avis.titre: Thick and creamy for glowing skin
avis.texte: This heavy duty body moisturizer is a fantastic all around body lotion —ultra thick and creamy. I use this for my face but also neck area. It doesn't have a scent.

avis.titre: Yes I would certainly buy this product again.
avis.texte: I like this product very much, it makes my face feel nice and smooth.

avis.titre: A great everyday moisturizer that keeps my skin soft and ...
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for a while, and I'm really happy with the results. It has a lightweight, pleasant texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky or greasy feeling. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and looks more fresh and radiant after applying it. It works great as part of my daily skincare routine and sits well under makeup. The product feels comfortable on the skin, and a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for.a lightweight moisturizer that gives the skin a healthy glow.
Since I've tried this product including "When hope is not enough " I have broke out in a rash with hives. Please share what I should do for repair, I've never had this experience before.

My sister who lives in Chicago was the one who told me about this.she is older but has not been in Southern California all her life furthest from the ocean 15 miles.i have as they say sun damage skin. i love this moisturizer. it really gives me skin a smooth glow. i'm obsessed with the finish of this product and i can't wait to keep using it! my skin absorbs it so good!

avis.titre: It has officially earned a permanent spot in my daily rou...
avis.texte: ​Amazing moisturizer! The texture feels so pleasant and luxurious on the skin. It brings out a beautiful, radiant glow that is perfect for my skin—leaving it smooth and deeply hydrated all day. It has officially earned a permanent spot in my daily routine. Thank you, Philosophy, for this amazing product!
Great moisturizer and SPF combo. This moisturizer is an all in one step which is great for my morning skincare routine. It doesn't pill on my skin.

I was very excited to try this product as I love philosophy products. The moisturizer is very creamy and my skin feels moisturized after using this. I so like that it contains spf. However, it also contains a slight sunscreen smell that I'm not super fond of. Otherwise this is a great moisturizer!

THIS PRODUCT IS THICKKKK! Which i love. A little goes a long way. I add this to my face and my neck along with my chest area. It is light also. Doesn't clog my pores, however I do not use it daily. I also apply it at night or in the morning on days I'm not going anywhere. It does leave you super slippery lol. I haven't dont any makeup over this product yet but im sure it provides a beautiful nourished application.

avis.titre: Very creamy and pleasant smelling Moisturizer
avis.texte: This moisturizer delivers exceptional dehydration and visibly smooths out uneven texture. I absolutely love the soft creamy texture and fresh pleasant scents. It feels incredibly luxurious upon application, however, as someone with combination skin and an already T-Zone the formula feels a bit too thick to my liking using it during a hot summer. They leave my skin feeling slightly weighed down and greasy in oil-prone areas. It is a fantastic resurfacing product, but it works much better as a rich nighttime treatment when the weather heats up.

I really enjoyed using this moisturizer. It has a lightweight, creamy texture that absorbs nicely to my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. My skin feels hydrated, softer, and smoother after pplying it, and it gives a healthy-looking glow that looks fresh but not shiny. I also like that it ayers well under makeup and works easily as part of my everyday skincare routine. Overall, it's • great moisturizer for anyone who wants hydration with a smooth, radiant finish.

It's a nice enough moisturizer. It goes on pretty thick so you do not need a lot. It has 30 spf which is nice, but that means you're trying to rub in white residue and it leaves you with an oily/glossy residue on the skin.
I have the night face cream but needed something for the day with SPF. This works so well. It blends in nicely, melting into my skin quickly and no residue. Leaves my face soft and moisturized.

This is an awesome skin cream and i love that it has SPF! This is a must for summer ! Its silky smooth and leaves my skin looking super glowy and hydrated. The glow last all day and makes me feel radiant and beautiful. So far my skin has been loving it especially in this crazy summer heat. Ive been usuing it daily and dont leave the house without it. I tend to get skin discoloration if i dont wear sunscreen and this face cream has help alot to prevent it from happening!

This is a great way to start the day! I am so glad to find a sunscreen that is thick and creamy but also comfortable and invisible on my face. It's packed full of great skincare ingredients, and it doesn't have a strong fragrance. My face feels moisturized but not at all greasy.

I love this product! It's a thick moisturizer but absorbs quickly - perfect for my dry skin. It leaves a glowy, radiant finish to the skin after applying. My makeup lays well on top of it too! Be careful applying around your eyes because of the spf if you have sensitive eyes like mine. This is my new go to morning moisturizer!
I love how smooth & lightweight this moisturizer is & there is no smell.its super thin as well not a thick consistency at all I can put this on whenever during the day & not feel so greasy.

Its very hydrating and smooth and it feels super good on the skin, and doesn't leave a white cast or shadow. One thing is that it does burn my eyes a bit maybe because my eyes are more sensitive and dryer than other people. Other than that it's great and it smell so good too.

The texture is super thick. It doesn't absorb at all and feels like a layer of wax on my skin. On top of that, it has a shimmery white cast like a mineral sunscreen, but this is made with the worst of the worst chemical sunscreen ingredients. The only thing it has going for it is the scent is light and pleasant, though I don't do scented facial products. No thanks! It might have been free, but it's not for me.
I love this sunscreen! It blends in so nicely, and leaves a great glow. The jar feels nice and expensive. I those that it has other skincare ingredients that help your skin be its best.
The texture starts of thick. But it blends very easily. I'm not comfortable with jar kind of skincare products - which is why I might not reach for it. Otherwise the ingredients are great.

First off the packaging of this moisturizer feels very heavy and luxurious. Second, it's definitely giving off more sunscreen vibes than moisturizer. It has SPF 30 and it takes a little work to get the product to blend. I like to use this on my tattoo because I don't typically remember all the time to use SPF and it's quick and easy for me to use this. It definitely feels greasy on my skin the way a sunscreen would so if you have sensitive skin or break out easily you may want to avoid this. It does have glycolic and hylaronic acid in it as well.

avis.titre: Lightweight moisturizer that hydrates, smooths, and leave...
avis.texte: I really enjoy this moisturizer because it leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and noticeable smoother. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, making it easy to wear on its own or under makeup. It gives my skin a healthy glow while keeping it comfortable throughout the day. A little goes a long way, and the formula feels luxurious without being heavy.

This cream is so smooth and silky and goes on the skin so nicely and feels amazing. Hydrates the skin really nicely as well. And I love that it has the SPF in it. Has a nice soft, sent nothing chemically or overly fragrant. It makes my skin feel so soft and so hydrated. It lasts all day keeping skin soft and glowy. Feels so good! I am enjoying it very much! I highly recommend for any skin type including sensitive. ☺️

Wow wow wow!!! Philosophy hope in a jar is a moisturizer with spf30, and let me tell you I been using this everyday and it's lightweight, doesn't feel greasy, and doesn't mess with my makeup application! I also haven't had any breakouts on my skin with hope. It smells like flowers and it's worth every penny! I will always buy more once I run out!

avis.titre: Lightweight formula and gives glow after a week of contin...
avis.texte: I want to start by saying I really like the smooth texture of the moisturizer. It was very gentle on my sensitive skin. After a week of usage I started to see some minute changes in the texture of my skin. My face became more bright and even (at least that's what I felt). Do use sunscreen for sure with it since it has glycolic acid.

I have really enjoying this moisturizer. It feels lightweight, gives my skin a healthy glow, and leaves it feeling soft and hydrated without being heavy. My skin looks smoother and more refreshed every time I use it.
The Smooth go moisturizer with SPF makes my skin look bright and youthful.

That moisturizer has been amazing. Definitely has given my skin more life. I can tell a difference. It absorbs so well and it's not greasy. I didn't have any breakouts or irritation. The scent is light and pleasant too! Amazing stuff!

Philosophy Hope in a jar SPF 30 smooth glow moisturizer is my new go to! It has that classic hope in a jar scent that I love, leaves my face moisturized and gives sun protection! The packaging feels luxurious and looks great on my counter, so I remember to use it daily. Highly recommend!
Loved the silky smooth texture. It feels so satisfying while applying on the skin. It keeps the skin smooth and hydrated. It has fragrance though.
The consistency is thicker than I thought. However, it feels very light when I put on my face. Love it how it has spf. What a great day cream. Price point is also pretty reasonable

I was quite surprised how heavy the jar was, definitely giving quality right off the bat. I've used this as my face sunscreen the few pool days we have had and working in the yard. It did a great job, I got no sun burn at all, I actually feel like I got some nice color on my face. I have adult acne and this product did not cause me to break out at all. The moisturizer is nice and thick and provides great coverage. I did get some pilling of the product when I tried to layer something on it tho. I would probably stick to wearing it only.
Smooth glow multi tasking moisturizer is new to me. The product went on smooth and silky. Left my skin feeling soft and healthy definitely will use this again

avis.titre: Lightweight hydration with a healthy glow
avis.texte: I really been enjoying this moisturizer .The packaging feels clean and practical ,and the cream has a light ,fresh scant that isn't overpowering .The texture is smooth and lightweight ,so it's spreads easily and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling greasy.It keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day and gives a healthy ,natural looking glow

Philosophy is a brand we all have seen. Philosophy's hope in a jar spf 30 is a very moisturizing multi-tasking broad spectrum spf 30 . A little goes a long way. It is very scented so if you're sensitive, beware!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This moisturizer is seriously a game-changer for my skin! I love that it has SPF 30 built right in, so I don't have to worry about an extra step for sun protection. It leaves my face feeling super smooth and hydrated without any greasiness. Plus, the fresh, clean scent is just delightful. Honestly, it's become an essential part of my skincare.
I love the smell of this moisturizer! It leaves my face feeling super soft! The packaging is a nice thick jar! I also love the add bonus of sunscreen and the fact it doesn't smell like it either
This is the perfect summertime moisturizer! It absorbs quick and leaves your skin feeling dewy and glowing. It has a lovely creamy cosistemc- a little bit goes a long way!
This moisturizer is really good. It is very thick but once it goes on it feels light weight. There is a light fragrance to it, it is not overpowering. This gives my skin a nice glow.

Confusing product because it has sunscreen ingredients but also AHAs (glycolic acid). I don't use AHAs during the daytime so I didn't really want to use it regularly. I mostly used it on days that i was just at home, not going outside just to be safe. As for the performance, it did not leave a white cast on my skin which was great and it absorbed well as a moisturizer but like I said, I wouldn't use this regularly because I just can't get past the glycolic acid during the daytime
This Philosophy smooth-glow multi-tasking moisturizer is wonderful! I love the SPF protection that's packed in. My skin feels moisturized, protected and nourished.

The packaging is beautiful and beautifully done. The consistency is nice and thick and you do not need a lot of this product. It sits well on the skin and gives it a nice glow! I would definitely recommend!

Lightweight, hydrating, and perfect for everyday use! 🤍 I love that it moisturizes my skin while providing SPF 30 protection. It leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and naturally radiant. A great addition to my daily skincare routine! ✨

So good! I find myself reaching for this moisturizer time and time again each morning! I love the at it has SPF and isn't greasy. It also rubs in really well and doesn't smell like normal moisturizer with SPF.

Rich silky and creamy, this moisturizer goes on smooth and soaks into the skin and leaves your skin hydrated and feeling great. The smell is lovely, however it may be too strong for someone who doesnt like strong scents.

I am always a fan of the Philosophy jars and this cream is nice, thick and hydrating. I do love that it contains spf without the spf scent. I do wish it was such a fragrant scent though because when my rosacea is flaring up this product does irritate it more.

Love that this lotion has hydronic acid, spf and more built into an all-in-one formula. The lotion is a very thick cream and leaves a dewy finish. I would highly recommend this for a winter skincare routine

avis.titre: Hydrates, protects and gives a beautiful glow
avis.texte: I'm loving this Philosophy Hope in a jar smooth glow multi-tasking moisturizer spectrum spf30. It has a great consistency that absorbs without residue. It's clean presentation and impressive effectiveness in hydrating and protecting, along with it's all day durability. It's so light and yet incredibly hydrating.

I was worried about the thickness and the white cast of the moisturizer right away, but it blends down to invisible and the texture is actually very comfortable once it is massaged into the skin. I didn't experience any breakouts with this. I loved the convenience of having the sunscreen and moisturizer in one.

Very portable with good amount size. It does not leave your face greasy. The cream prenetrates on your skin very well. It does not have smell. Very durable. I love that protect your skin from the sun light. Leave yiur sking soft.

This moisturizer is nice and thick and creamy. A little goes a long way and it felt surprisingly light on my skin. It absorbed well and my skin felt hydrated all day. I found this made my skin look glowy and feel soft! I think its a little too thick for me to use for the summer but my skin will love this all winter.

This hope in a jar is a nice refreshing change to the usual moisturizer. It's lightweight and goes on smooth. I love that it includes the spf 30 as I burn easily in the sun. Has a tiny smidge of greasiness but I will use it without worry. It soaks in nicely.
This moisturizer is light weight, a little goes a long way, and the absorption takes about 4 seconds. There's no irritation. It's not too greasy and has spf 30 to help prevent sunburn.
It's a beautiful moisturizer. Keeps my skin hydrated and love the way it feels on my skin. The jar is quite heavy but it just speaks to the quality of the product.

I LOVE everything about this! It feels nice on the skin, smells wonderful, works as SPF, doesn't make me feel greasy. Truly will be repurchasing when I run out since it's actually game changing compared to the other sunscreens I have

No irritation after using it for a while now, smells like normal face cream no sweet or fancy scent which I really appreciate. The quantity isn't much but for a good product you don't need a lot anyway

This moisturizer is packed with great ingredients that are super beneficial for your skin. It also contains spf, which is really good. If you have dry skin, you will really like this product because it is super emollient, but if you have oily skin like me, it will probably be too much glow.

avis.titre: Good moisturiser but with some downsides.

I love especially packaging and glass container. Looks expensive. Cream is smooth and absorbs well. The only downside is some not very clean ingredients in cream (for SPF protection). Otherwise, it's a fair deal
If you love luminous glow this is perfect sunscreen .A small amount goes a long way .The skin is so hydrated .It smells so good .Perfect for all seasons

The Hope in a Jar by Philosophy is one of my favorite skincare products so far! It has a great formula that moisturises the face very well. Additionally, while having spf 30, it does not leave my face feeling sticky. It prevents sunburn effectively! I am a big fan of the glass jar since I dislike microplastics.
Loving this moisturizer!!! The ingredients are great and work well with my sensitive skin. Absorbs fairly quickly. It doesn't mix very good with my foundation unfortunately.

I've really enjoyed using Philosophy Hope In A Jar Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Facial Moisturizer. The formula feels lightweight yet hydrating, and it leaves my skin looking and feeling noticeably smoother and more radiant. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy and gives my skin a healthy glow that lasts throughout the day.

avis.titre: Awesome moisturizer whose benefits are worth the price!
avis.texte: I LOVE this moisturizer! The consistency is thick and luxurious, the smell is lovely and not at all over powering. But the biggest thing is how well it absorbs. I have on a toner, eye cream and serum, do you can imagine how awesome it is to have cream that pulls all of that goodness into my skin. It makes my face feel like velvet, and when I go to do my nighttime routine (I go twice a day) my skin is still noticeably hydrated from that morning. It's always iffy with a product on the pricier end of the spectrum being worth the price, but this does, in spades.

avis.titre: Smells great, non greasy , and protects the skin!
avis.texte: I loved this facial moisturizer and sunscreen! It smells great, goes on smoothly, and protects the skin from harmful sun damage. It also lasts a while and keeps your skin feeling soft. It was great for vacation and slipped in my purse easily, for quick touch ups, whixhbI didn't need much of. It also absorbs easily without shine and greasy feeling. Definitely makes you feel like you are CB using a quality product, because it is a quality product!

This moisturizer feels too thick for daily use and much more appropriate as a night cream. But I tried it for day use and, although a tad oily, it stood up particularly well both in terms of hydration and makeup compatibility. No breakouts or irritation here. I never tested the spf capabilities. Overall, I'll finish the container, but will likely return to my standard daily spf moisturizer.

This is a really great moisturizing sunscreen! The consistency and texture are great and it never seems too heavy. It kept me from getting sunburned and I'm pretty fair skinned. It also didn't irritate my skin in any way. It absorbed nicely and wore well under my makeup. I docked a half star because I really had to blend for a while so it didn't leave any white cast and it did make my skin look somewhat greasy after hours of wear. It also has a definite sunscreen smell but that doesn't really bother me. I'd recommend this sunscreen
This moisturizer is very hydrating and has a great scent that isn't over powering. It gives your skin a glow and fresh look. It is great for any type of skin.

I love a moisturizer that has SPF, big fan of that. This has a whipped, fluffy texture to it and has almost no scent. It applies easily and feels smooth and non-greasy. I feel it may be a bit thick for daily use underneath makeup, so I don't really like it for that. I'd say this is a good daily morning moisturizer for no or light makeup days. I didn't have any breakouts or skin sensitivity with this. Overall I say give it a try!

avis.titre: I really like this one so far
avis.texte: I found that this moisturizer absorbs amazingly well! It leaves no white cast on my skin and it lays well under my foundation. It's not sticky. It doesn't feel heavy on my skin. And my skin is hydrated and protected for the sun. It does have a bit of a sunscreen scent but I didn't find it overwhelming

The definitely has a very perfume like smell, which is concerning for me given the fact that I have pretty sensitive skin. Goes on smooth and well and does have SPF 30 . So, this is great for skin protection and hydration but I definitely can't keep applying it like it recommends without my face reacting poorly. Overall, still a great product.￼

This is a nice thick moisturizer that spreads out evenly across my skin. Even though it's thick, it does not feel too heavy and leaves my skin feeling soft. I like the added sunscreen, so it saves me a step in the morning. The scent is light and is not too overpowering. I really enjoy using this moisturizer everyday.
My favorite face cream! I loved its texture, the packaging, the fragrance, and especially how soft and hydrated it leaves my skin. And the results are amazing!

This moisturizer adds a great dewy glow in the morning. It's thick and creamy, but it blends nicely. It worked well under my makeup. It's a light clean scent. I love that it has spf. I did feel like it was a little heavy for my oily skin.

avis.titre: Hope in a jar is a fitting name!
avis.texte: I was absolutely thrilled to receive this offer to test out in exchange for my thoughts, as I've been wanting to try this particular cream for a long time! It did not disappoint! It is incredibly luxurious and hydrating as a moisturizer, so much so that I did a double take to confirm that it is also a sunscreen! Sun protection is so vital, but nobody wants a white cast smelly layer! This totally fixes that issue and helps me protect my skin from the rays in comfort!

When my dermatologist recommended that I start using retinol, she emphasized the importance of wearing sunscreen every day. Because retinol can increase sun sensitivity, finding a moisturizer with reliable SPF protection became a priority. The opportunity to try Philosophy's Hope in a Jar SPF 30 moisturizer (c/o Influenster) came at the perfect time. One feature I especially appreciate is that it combines a daily moisturizer and sunscreen in a single step. Not only does that simplify my morning routine, it means I don't have to wait for separate products to absorb before applying makeup. In addition to SPF 30 protection, the moisturizer contains glycolic acid to support gentle exfoliation and skin renewal, along with hyaluronic acid to help maintain hydration. Despite these active ingredients, I found it gentle enough for my sensitive skin. A small, dime-sized amount is all that's needed. I used too much the first time I applied it and noticed a white cast on my skin, but once I scaled back the amount, the moisturizer blended in much more naturally. It has a light scent and a smooth texture that leaves a subtle glow. It layers nicely underneath makeup.

avis.titre: Glowing, hydrated skin and SPF protection—all in one mois...
avis.texte: Philosophy's hope in a jar smooth-glow multitasking facial moisturizer with SPF 30 has quickly become one of my favorite daily skincare products. It leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated, soft, and noticeably smoother without feeling heavy or greasy. I love that it combines moisturizer and sun protection in one step, making my morning routine that much easier. The lightweight formula, absorbs easily, and gives my skin a healthy, radiant glow that lasts all day. If you're looking for a moisturizer that hydrates, protects, and gives your skin and natural glow, this one is definitely worth trying!

I have combination skin and my first impression when I saw this cream was: I think it's not my type, it's very heavy; but to my surprise it wasn't like that. Despite having a slightly heavy consistency, it absorbs very well in the skin without leaving a greasy feeling and don't brake me out either. I use it whenever I require more deep hydration or after using retinoids and of course as a bonus, it has SPF30 🥰. And the packaging screams luxury because its glass case packaging, I love it.

I absolutely love the Philosophy smooth-glow multi-tasking moisturizer. The scent doesn't smell nothing like sunscreen at all. You wouldn't even know you have sunscreen on because it smells nothing like it at all. It doesn't residue like most sunscreen does when you put it on your face. You can also wear it underneath your makeup and it won't even mess it up or make it look smudge. If your gonna use a sunscreen on your face ladies I different recommend this product. I promise you won't regret it at all.

Loveeeee this philosophy sunscreen/moisturizer! Not only does it protect from the sun's harmful rays, but it moisturizes and adds a dewey glow that isn't greasy. It's high quality, thick—but spreads so easily. The smell is light and pleasant! Love the cute little jar! Easy on/off. I use it on my face, neck, and chest daily. Does well under makeup!

Multitasking cream that gives deep and long-lasting hydration, lightweight and gentle on sensitive skin, easy application and pairs perfect under makeup, no greasy feeling or residue, leaves my skin soft and dewy and has prevent my skin from getting breakouts

avis.titre: Effective but not for all skin types
avis.texte: I was excited to try this since I will be outside a lot this summer and wanted a face moisturizer with SPF. This definitely provides the protection that you need. I am very fair and wore this on very sunny and hot days and I had no sunburn whatsoever. My biggest issue with this product is how heavy it is on the skin. I have oily skin which only gets worse when it's hot. When first putting this on it is VERY dewy and that lasts a long time. I could feel this laying on my skin even hours later. It has the consistency of not only sunscreen but a full coverage foundation but without the actual coverage. I'm very militant about washing my face and I still had a few pimples from this. Obviously your mileage may vary depending on your skin type. I will definitely still use this up but will be sure I'm not having my picture taken and will be a short outing so I can wash it off.
The Philosophy smooth-glow multi-tasking moisturizer is the bomb. Leaves my skin with a soft yet glowy luminous look, provides all day protection against the sun and has a light pleasant clean smell.

I've been testing this moisturizer out and the first thing i noticed about it was the texture. It's a very rich, creamy moisturizer but not overly heavy at all! I also love how it also has SPF 30 so great for the mornings.

avis.titre: The perfect all in one SPF
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying this philosophy hope in a jar smooth glow moisturizer SPF 30 lately. It gives my skin the perfect mix of hydration, glow, and daily sun protection all in one step. It feels moisturizing without being too heavy and is gentle on sensitive skin without breaking you out, plus you need only a small amount to cover your face. ￼￼￼￼￼￼￼
This is the only moisturizer I use. It leaves my skin smooth and hydrated to the point where I don't need to use any primer.

I've been using Philosophy's Hope In A Jar Smooth Glow Multi-Tasking Day Cream SPF 30 for several weeks now and I'm so impressed! The texture is lightweight, silky, and absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy or heavy. It gives my skin an instant healthy glow while providing enough hydration to keep my skin comfortable all day. Plus, having SPF 30 built in makes my morning routine so much easier. What I love most is how well it layers under makeup. It creates a smooth, hydrated base that helps my foundation apply evenly and look more radiant throughout the day. I've noticed my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more refreshed since adding this cream to my routine. The subtle glow it provides makes my complexion look healthy without appearing shiny. This is a fantastic multi-tasker for anyone looking for hydration, sun protection, and a radiant finish in one product. If you want a moisturizer that leaves your skin feeling soft, plump, and glowing while working beautifully under makeup, I highly recommend giving this one a try. A little goes a long way, and it's become a staple in my morning skincare routine.

avis.titre: My newest addition to my morning skin care routine
avis.texte: What a fabulous find. Thanks Influenster for allowing me to try out this product for my honest review. It has been amazing the past few weeks using this and I will be buying another jar as soon as I'm out. It feels so nice and luxurious on my skin. It doesn't feel greasy and leaves a bit of shine only for a little bit. I like the thick consistency and the way it melts onto my skin. There is no real scent and it goes well with my sensitive normal to dry skin.

avis.titre: A glowy skin moisturizer with spf 30
avis.texte: The Philosophy smooth-glow multi-tasking moisturizer is a great moisturizer/sunscreen with SPF 30. It leaves your skin looking extra glowy and also works well under makeup. However it does feel somewhat heavy on the skin due to being a thick consistency. It is also heavily fragranced so if you don't like that from skin care products you might want to skip this one. Overall if you're looking for something that makes your skin glow and is also a sunscreen you would probably like this one!

avis.titre: Love the healthy glow for my skin!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Philosophy Hope in a Jar, Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Moisturizer! From the first uses, my skin felt noticeably softer, smoother, and more hydrated. The lightweight texture absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy, and it leaves my skin looking fresh and radiant throughout the day. It also gives my skin a very healthy glow, which I love. What I appreciate most is that it provides deep hydration while also helping to improve skin texture and brightness. My complexion looks more even and healthy, and I have noticed a natural healthy glow that wasn't there before. It layers well under makeup and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.
